<thought>We need a template that converts an aliphatic carboxylic acid and a primary amine into an amide. Using the correct functional group name "aliphatic carboxylic acid" will allow the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
